semantics: Family correspondence with optional per-family selectors over published geometric record fields, independently of labels. All selectors on a family must match; unselected families retain every record. Only defining faces count; bottom labels and constituent faces do not expand predictions. Identical face sets across mapped families are one prediction. Stock is not covered: polygonal_stock describes a body, not residual unmachined faces.

classes.name: chamfer
classes.rationale: The internal scorer keeps principal chamfers and oriented_chamfers separately, while recognition schema 6 publishes both as chamfers. oriented_chamfers proves a complete planar replacement bevel between two supports, including material-side and virtual-corner evidence; the same defining-face set is deduplicated across families.

classes.name: rectangular_passage
classes.rationale: An enclosed rectangular through cut. Rust publishes principal rectangles as section_passages and non-principal rectangles as oriented_slots; independent OpenCascade aligned and rotated box-minus-prism constructions verify both representations.

classes.name: triangular_through_slot
classes.rationale: Two rectangular planar walls meet concavely at a straight trough edge; their opposite lips lie in one open plane, and both run ends open to exterior planar faces. The v_channels family proves this V-section through-channel geometry, without selecting by labels or preferring a section angle. A wall pair contained in a proved closed passage is excluded as part of that complete section.

classes.name: rectangular_through_slot
classes.rationale: The generator extrudes a rectangle anchored to one stock edge through the stock normal. Along that through axis the remaining boundary is a U-section: two opposed walls and a floor, open at both ends. This is Rust channels, not the enclosed passage/slot interpretation. Verified with an independent OpenCascade box-minus-prism construction.

classes.name: circular_through_slot

section_recesses.evidence: A proved open section swept between two open run ends is a through channel.
The published circular open profile is the concave cylindrical trough; cylindrical_seats proves the original support, open mouth and both open ends by coverage and volume probes.

classes.rationale: The existing section_recesses family already publishes proved circular open channels, including the semicircular trough of circular_through_slot. Select its published channel and circular classification, without changing recognition or using labels.

classes.name: Oring
classes.rationale: A blind annular face recess: a planar annular floor region joins a complete outer concave cylinder and inner convex cylinder, both ending at the same open plane. The annular_grooves family proves every floor piece and both cylindrical walls on one valid solid; split rims must be complete circular cycles. Existing grooves are external shaft bands and do not describe this geometry. No nominal O-ring size or function is inferred.

classes.name: v_circular_end_blind_slot
classes.rationale: A complete semicylindrical floor tangent to two rectangular vertical sides, swept from an open run end to a planar blind cap. The semicircular_blind_slots family proves that geometry and its open lateral mouth on one strictly valid solid. The older round_bottom_blind_slots family describes two quarter-cylinder corners with a flat floor, which is the h_circular_end_blind_slot geometry, not this class.

classes.name: h_circular_end_blind_slot
classes.rationale: Open U-section with two quarter-circle corners and a flat between them, extruded to a blind cap.

classes.name: triangular_blind_step
classes.rationale: Triangular sketch anchored to two stock edges, cut blind: an oblique corner face and triangular terminal.

classes.name: rectangular_blind_step
classes.rationale: Rectangular sketch anchored to two stock edges, cut blind: a corner notch (pockets edge_anchored).

classes.name: stock
classes.not_covered: Residual stock faces have no recognition family.
